data.narrative:
Skyeton is a growth-stage company operating in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Oleksandr Stepura. The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. This represents a 26-company peer pool within Defense & Security, though sub-segments remain dispersed.

Peer-median valuation proves inapplicable here. The standard comparable-company method requires a minimum of three same-stage or adjacent-stage peers within a similar valuation tier; the available dataset yields zero matches on all three dimensions simultaneously. A broad sector median would obscure material differences in technology, go-to-market strategy, and capital intensity across defense subsegments and would introduce unacceptable estimation error.

Without sufficient clustering among growth-stage Defense & Security peers, triangulation via multiples-based approaches cannot proceed reliably. The analysis therefore cannot support a quantitative valuation range at this time. Resolution requires either: (1) identification of additional same-stage private comps with disclosed or estimated valuations, (2) application of forward revenue or bookings multiples if Skyeton's financials are available, or (3) transaction-based benchmarking should M&A or secondary data emerge. Key uncertainties remain the target's revenue scale, growth trajectory, and specific defense subsector positioning relative to the sparse peer set.
